messages:
Nora: Heads-up: vendor pentest booked 2026-09-15 09:00-16:30 UTC. Need RBAC freeze window, KMS decrypt-proxy (no key export), immutable audit snapshot, presigned evidence handoff, and a remediation owner. Volunteers?

Sam: I can own RBAC freeze + rollback playbook. Propose freeze 08:30-17:00 UTC for pre/post buffers. Will publish affected service principals by EOD.

Eli: I'll build the KMS decrypt-proxy pattern: assessor assumes ephemeral role, lambda validates object path and calls KMS:Decrypt, returns result to presigned URL. No key materials shared. Need assessor account ID and allowed prefixes.

Tara: Platform will produce a timeboxed export of CloudTrail + host logs for the window, object-locked in pt-readroom/snapshots/2199994000.tar.gz and publish sha256 in the manifest. Delivery via presigned GET valid 72h. Retention 60 days.

Ops Bot: Created ticket SEC-PT-8120: RBAC freeze + decrypt-proxy + readroom export. Assignees: @Sam, @Eli, @Tara. ETA: initial artifacts 36h.

Nora: Acceptance criteria: add one-liners to SEC-PT-8120 by EOD (examples: "Snapshot exported + sha256 verified", "Assessors decrypt only via proxy for assigned prefixes"). Pre-check call Wed 09:15 UTC 15m.

Sam: Draft freeze snippet (will scope to ARNs):

```
Deny iam:CreateRole, iam:PutRolePolicy during window; pause CI/CD deploys; record rollback steps.
```

Eli: KMS policy notes: use Condition kms:ViaService = "s3.amazonaws.com" and aws:SourceAccount = "333322221111" (assessor); bind encryption context to object id. No iam:PassRole to assessor.

Tara: Ops: please pause key rotation for alias/pt-readroom-key during the window. Also confirm object-lock governance mode is available for export objects.

Ops Bot: Rotation pause scheduled for alias/pt-readroom-key from 2026-09-15T06:00Z to 2026-09-15T20:00Z. Noted on SEC-PT-8120.

Nora: Triage: Sam primary, Eli backup. If a critical customer-facing failure occurs, escalate to IR bridge and follow incident runbook. If retest fails, we'll schedule a 48h remediation sprint and a re-run window.

Sam: I'll run a dry-run Fri 08:00 UTC to validate freeze + manifest export + rollback. Will include a smoke bundle.

Eli: I'll deploy decrypt-proxy to staging and capture CloudTrail entries so decrypt calls surface under proxy role for audit.

Tara: I'll produce a sample snapshot and verify sha256; will attach small sample to SEC-PT-8120.

Nora: Thanks team. Ping here for blockers. :white_check_mark:
